$comment: Onboard Automation Bridge — config reference. The extension stores these in chrome.storage.local; the popup's 'Email & Storage Config' panel is the UI. The ImprovMX defaults below SHIP pre-filled (the popup falls back to them when a key was never saved), so a fresh install runs the email presets with zero configuration. This file is documentation — the extension does not read it. For automation, set the same keys via chrome.storage.local.
$serverUrl: (optional) ws://127.0.0.1:3000 for the local dev daemon, or wss://<your-preview-host>/ in the sandbox — set via the popup's Server Connection box, not here
$authToken: (optional) only if the daemon was started with --token
